messages:
Sam C: Heads up — offsite in Chicago next Tues (12 ppl). Where should we do dinner near West Loop / River North? Walkable preferred. No deep-dish please :sweat_smile:
Anya P: Girl & the Goat is great but needs booking weeks ahead. For 12 might be tight.
Liam (Eng): The Gilt Bar next to Girl & the Goat has a bigger space and sometimes does group seating. Parachute (Korean) is a bit of a trek but totally worth it.
Omar: The Publican is awesome for groups — long tables, good beer program, very West Loop.
Rachel: Sunda in River North for Asian-fusion small plates — easy to share.
Ben S: If folks want casual, Au Cheval for burgers but LONG wait. Might be rough for 12 unless we reserve a table early.
Susan (People Ops): I can call and reserve — what's the budget per head? We usually aim $50-70 for offsite dinners.
André: Ema does mezze-style plates and is pretty group-friendly. Also Fat Rice is cool if people want something quirky.
Sam C: Budget around $60/head. Prefer something that can seat us together and take one check.
Anya P: Also request: no stairs-only venue — one guest has accessibility needs.
Liam (Eng): The Publican has main-floor seating and is accessible. I'll DM the floor plan.
Omar: Quick votes: Publican 👍, Sunda 👍, Girl & The Goat 👀 (needs early book).
Rachel: +1 Publican. Also consider Frontera Grill for reliable Mexican and easy group seating.
Ben S: For something by Union Station, Country Cat is solid comfort food and walkable from a few hotels.
Susan (People Ops): I'll try Publican first for a 7pm slot and ask for a single check. If it's full I'll call Sunda as a fallback. Will update here by EOD tomorrow.
Sam C: Amazing — thanks Susan :heart:
André: If Publican confirms, can someone compile dietary restrictions? I'll send a quick Google form.
Susan (People Ops): Good call — leaving a note to post form link once venue is locked.
Sam C: Perfect. Appreciate the quick recs, team!
